name: FleekCode – Omnibus Price Tracker
author: fleekcode

sections.description:
📊 FleekCode – Omnibus Price Tracker is the ultimate solution for WooCommerce store owners who need to comply with the Omnibus Directive. This powerful plugin automatically tracks and displays the minimum price of your products over a specified period, ensuring transparency and compliance with EU regulations.

🌟 Why Choose FleekCode?
– ✅ 100% Compliance: Meet Omnibus Directive requirements with ease.
– 🕒 Automatic Tracking: No manual work – prices are tracked automatically.
– 💡 Flexible Display: Show the minimum price where it matters most.
– 📈 Price History: Keep a detailed record of all price changes.
– 🛠️ Easy Setup: Get started in minutes with our user-friendly interface.

Key Features 🔥

✨ Price Tracking
– Automatically tracks price changes for all products.
– Supports both simple and variable products.

✨ Minimum Price Display
– Displays the lowest price over a customizable period (e.g., 30 days).
– Flexible display options: before or after the current price.

✨ Customizable Text
– Fully customize the text that displays the minimum price.
– Use placeholders like %price% and %days% for dynamic content.

✨ Price History
– View detailed price history for each product.
– Easily enable/disable historical prices from being displayed.

✨ WooCommerce Integration
– Seamlessly integrates with your WooCommerce store.
– Adds a dedicated tab for price history in the product editor.

✨ User-Friendly Settings
– Intuitive settings page for easy configuration.
– Set the number of days to track prices and customize display options.

License

FleekCode – Omnibus Price Tracker is licensed under the GPLv2 or later. 📜
sections.installation:
1. Upload the fleekcode-omnibus folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure the plugin by going to FleekCode Omnibus Price Tracker.
  4. Customize the display text and set the number of days to track prices.
sections.faq:
What is the Omnibus Directive?

The Omnibus Directive is a European Union regulation that requires online sellers to display the lowest price of a product over the last 30 days. This ensures transparency for consumers.

Does this plugin work with variable products?

Yes! The plugin fully supports both simple and variable WooCommerce products. 🎉

Can I customize the text that displays the minimum price?

Absolutely! You can fully customize the text in the plugin settings. Use placeholders like %price% and %days% to make it dynamic. ✍️

Where is the price history stored?

The price history is stored in a secure custom database table created by the plugin. You can access it from the product editor. 🗃️
